cases.text: Integrated Energy Factor (IEF): An efficiency measure expressed in liters per kilowatt-hour under test conditions.
Product Capacity: This measures moisture removed during a 24-hour test, in pints per day.
The dehumidifier rating has two dimensions. Water removal capacity is measured in pints per day; energy efficiency is measured in liters of water per kilowatt-hour.
Combined Energy Factor (CEF): The amount of test load dried per energy consumed, expressed in pounds per kilowatt-hour.
Maximum Test Cycle Time: A test criterion measured in minutes, distinct from energy efficiency.
Drying efficiency is measured by combined energy factor. The number alone is not a direct measure of fabric wear.
A brochure promotes a Superior Comfort Index (SCI), but no independent test method exists for that index.
The device does not measure Air Quality Rating (AQR), which has not been tested.
This machine includes a remote control (RC) and a filter system (FILT).
The historical Energy Factor (EF) was replaced by Integrated Energy Factor (IEF), a modern efficiency measure.
